procedure: Create and reopen Unity URP project; verify Console and standalone 3D graybox.
pass: No compile errors; recorded Editor/package versions and working scene.

procedure: InputTestFixture presses/releases A,D,LeftArrow,RightArrow; test System/Pause and UI mouse, navigation, Submit, Cancel at paused timeScale; search sources/settings.
pass: Every binding changes exactly one lane per press; legacy Input/GetKey/GetAxis/OnGUI input absent; New-only setting and all actions/maps wired.

procedure: 100 alternating and repeated edge commands, simultaneous left/right, queued opposite input, hold key; run 60 playing seconds.
pass: Indices always -1..1, target x -3.2/0/3.2; hold never auto-repeats; continuous forward progress only in Playing.

procedure: Enumerate transition table, duplicate singleton and duplicate commands; exit Play Mode while paused.
pass: Exactly one owner; illegal transitions no-op; state event once; Time.timeScale restored on destroy.

procedure: Travel equivalent 100 km with deterministic stepping; inspect seams at ordinary and origin-shift ticks; 30-minute visible soak.
pass: Adjacent endpoints differ <0.001 m; >=300 m road ahead, no visible gaps or holes; local positions bounded; distance monotonic.

procedure: Rent/return each key 1,000 times; exhaust all pools; restart 50 times; inspect identity and counters.
pass: Every instance reused, clean flags/colliders/particles; no double-return; no Playing Instantiate/Destroy; bounded active counts; exhaustion policy safe.

procedure: Collect coin and fuel, stay overlapping and duplicate delivery, re-rent same object, collect while full.
pass: Exactly +100 score / +30 fuel (clamped) per activation; pooling restores usability; feedback exactly once even when full.

procedure: Inspect inheritance; run stationary and moving cars; test swept box at 22 and 50 m/s, lane crossing, thin pickup, initial overlap and two moving bodies.
pass: All four types derive abstract Interactable and override virtual methods; stationary z constant before rebase; moving +8 m/s; every crossing detected once.

procedure: Hit a car, overlap for >1 s, hit a new car within grace, then another after grace.
pass: Lives 3→2 on first contact; consumed collision cannot damage twice; grace blocks new damage; next eligible collision removes exactly one; flash/sparks visible.

procedure: Fuel drains 100→0 in 50 playing seconds without pickup; refuel at 95; test life zero, fuel zero, both same tick and fuel arrival on depletion tick.
pass: Fuel max100; each death path one GameOver event; Lives reason wins ties; contact/refuel before end-of-tick drain allows rescue; no changes after death.

procedure: Evaluate difficulty at time/distance endpoints; collect coins; set best, quit process and relaunch.
pass: Speed and expected blocked slots nondecreasing to cap; score floor(distance)+100*coins; best=max(old,current), survives process exit; no Save every frame.

procedure: Pause for 10 wall-clock seconds while in lane transition and near pickup; resume with buttons/Escape.
pass: Distance, fuel, grace timers, traffic and fireworks unchanged; gameplay input queue cleared; UI responsive; no engine loop during pause.

procedure: 50 restarts from pause and GameOver; compare initial snapshot, active counts, callbacks and road layout.
pass: Center lane, lives3, fuel100, score0, elapsed/distance0, speed22, no stale contacts/VFX/voices, same seed schedule; best preserved.

procedure: Compare snapshot to five HUD fields at 720p/1080p and 4:3/21:9.
pass: All values agree (speed×3.6 displayed in km/h); fuel fill=value/100; no clipping; updated on panel enable.

procedure: Inspect rear camera in all lanes, tunnel entries, moving and paused; trigger rebase and damage.
pass: Car and ≥120 m threat horizon visible; camera behind/above; no shake/rebase jump; roll does not alter collider.

procedure: Inspect sky/road/headlights; force measured speed22 then50, pause/resume, render fixed exposure comparison.
pass: Night sky visible on open sections; lit road and headlights; underglow light/emission monotone with actual speed; no exposure washout; streetlights visible.

procedure: Capture exhaust, spark, both pickup bursts, and open-sky launch/burst fireworks; toggle Bloom; pause mid-effect.
pass: All ParticleSystems present; fireworks visible within first open section; Bloom visibly affects emissives without hiding lanes; effects freeze/resume and return to pool.

procedure: Listen to music, engine, collision, coin and fuel; pause/restart repeatedly, saturate voice pool.
pass: Five cues audible, distinct pickups, engine speed response, no duplicated loops/clipping; correct mute/resume and bounded voices.

procedure: Exercise every required menu button with pointer and keyboard, including Quit in executable.
pass: Main: Start/Quit; Pause: Resume/Restart/Main Menu; Over: score/best/Restart; correct focus and no double action on Escape.

procedure: Record hardware; profile 10 minutes at 1080p after warmup at maximum density, then 30-minute soak.
pass: Target60 fps (p95≤16.7 ms) on declared PC; zero steady-state gameplay-script GC.Alloc; no pool growth; memory stable within10% after warmup. Targets are project budgets, not PDF grading thresholds.

procedure: Audit all R rows and test 1,000 seeds, maximum difficulty and 30-minute schedules using the corridor validator.
pass: Every required row has evidence; every generated block has a reachable protected route; moving traffic cannot enter it; pickups reachable; same seed gives same schedule.

procedure: Compare assignment.gitignore hash with project root; run git check-ignore and fresh-clone import.
pass: Exact supplied .gitignore preserved; Library/Temp/Obj/Builds ignored; Assets/meta, Packages and ProjectSettings present; no missing GUID references.

procedure: Extract submission to a new path on target OS; launch full build; open repository link from a second session.
pass: Executable and its data/dependencies work; accessible exact Git URL provided; no Editor needed.

procedure: Inspect final short report, screenshots, sources and credits.
pass: Architecture explained; real runtime images for each visual cluster; collaborators and exact source addresses credited; AI use disclosed honestly.

procedure: Validate naming, zipfile.testzip CRC, extract, compare SHA-256 to re-downloaded course ZIP and run extracted build.
pass: Three identity fields resolved, all delivery files present, no corruption; post-upload download verified by student.
